purpose: Describe whether the fixed 60-head model changes its 5-minute UP probability between positive and negative H1 EMA20 slope and compare with observed UP fractions on the same rows.
group_source: Previously noticed H1 slope sign tag from the own closed-H1 input; positive, negative and zero remain separate. Source-bound tags must match between candidate and baseline.
population: Fixed fold1 later 17288 parents, strict mature and observed nonzero 5-minute outcomes; original target identity.
uncertainty: 10000 paired calendar-block draws per UTC-day and UTC-week, using all parent dates before masking. For observed gap, model probability gap and model-minus-observed gap, use separate .05/6 intervals. No threshold fitting.
limitations: The H1 groups were noticed on the same reused fold and are exploratory, not a clean confirmation; day/week exchangeability unproved. Group differences are not individual-feature causal effects, proof of disconnection, economic edge or model interventions.
